Definition: Count of active employees with a current primary assignment.
Calculation_Logic: Count current Employee_Assignment_History records where Assignment_Status equals Current.

Definition: Count of active positions authorized in the approved establishment.
Calculation_Logic: Count Position_Master records where Approved_Position equals Yes and position is effective on the reporting date.

Definition: Count of positions with an approved people budget.
Calculation_Logic: Count Position_Master records where Budgeted_Position equals Yes and position is effective on the reporting date.

Definition: Approved positions without a current employee assignment.
Calculation_Logic: Approved Position Count minus filled approved positions, with a minimum of zero.

Definition: Budgeted positions without a current employee assignment.
Calculation_Logic: Count positions where Budgeted_Position equals Yes and Position_Status is Vacant or Frozen.

Definition: Difference between actual employees and approved positions.
Calculation_Logic: Actual Employee Count minus Approved Position Count.

Definition: Share of approved positions currently vacant.
Calculation_Logic: Vacant Approved Position Count divided by Approved Position Count multiplied by one hundred.

Definition: Share of approved people budget consumed by actual people costs.
Calculation_Logic: Total Actual People Cost divided by Total Approved People Budget multiplied by one hundred.

Definition: Sum of assignment capacity for current employees, allowing part-time and internship schedules.
Probability-weighted expected number of employees who may leave.
Calculation_Logic: Sum attrition probabilities for employees in the selected scope.

Definition: Employees available for work as a share of actual employees.
Calculation_Logic: Employees Available for Work divided by Actual Employee Count multiplied by one hundred.

Definition: Number of calendar days a position has remained vacant.
Calculation_Logic: Reporting date minus Vacancy Start Date.

Definition: Net change produced by joiners, leavers, and transfers.
Calculation_Logic: Joiners plus Transfers In minus Leavers minus Transfers Out.

Definition: Employees above the approved position count.
Calculation_Logic: Maximum of Actual Employee Count minus Approved Position Count and zero.

Definition: Difference between demand-driven staffing need and approved positions.
Calculation_Logic: Expected Staffing Need minus Approved Position Count.
